description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Aminatou, the Fateshifter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

uses.name: Spark Double
uses.cardState: as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it
